prompt: 한국 전기차 판매 동향을 조사해서 엑셀 파일로 정리해줘. 메인 컬러는 파랑으로 해줘.
assertions: An .xlsx file was produced and opens with openpyxl
Excel opens the file and recalculates it
A data sheet has an ID first column numbered 1..n
Header fill uses a blue main color
Charts are sensible (none on a sources sheet, no ID/rank series, rates not mixed with values)
No raw Markdown syntax in cells
Has a sources sheet with at least 5 distinct URLs
Uses [n] source markers at least 3 times
Numbers in data sheets are stored as numbers, not text
